collection.description: An apprentice wants to add a Moray Eel to the creature catalogue, but its habits are little known.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A Moray Eel is seen near the island's fish ponds or coastal waters. An apprentice wants to add it to the creature catalogue, but its habits are not well understood.

choices.label: Collect naturally shed material if any
Capture it for a permanent collection

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The apprentice sketches behavior and habitat; a later sighting may correct the drawing.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The keeper identifies care needs and cautions against assuming the animal is tame.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The record gains a physical reference only if suitable material is actually found.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The keeper challenges the plan if it risks the creature's life; rarity and welfare govern whether it proceeds.
